decisionsTitle: «Cronometrare»'s «… din N cu număr» counts the numbers the line takes, never one a cancellation retired
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-19, with a picture of «Cronometrare» saying «Ultimii sosiți 0 sosiți din 199 cu număr» and one of the registrations list saying «Alergători: 172 au acum un loc»:** «păi dacă eu am 172 de alergători… cum pot să am 199 cu număr?». The count was every real registration of the race that holds a race number, in any state — and a cancelled or expired registration keeps its number on its row, retired, so it is never given to anybody else (§173). Every runner who cancelled or became a volunteer after being numbered was counted among those who could still cross the line; the elite list's lines with a number, which the line does take (§986, §990), were not counted at all.

**Decision.** N is the numbers the line takes, as it resolves a press (`FinishTarget`): a confirmed real registration's, and a line of the race's elite list that has one — each number once. A retired number, a test row's and a line still without a number are not in it. Read with the page's other data in `results.ts#readFinishLine`, no query more. The number a cancellation retired stays on its row as before; only the count changes.
changelogLine: - **«Cronometrare» counts only who can finish** — «… din N cu număr» counts the confirmed runners' numbers and the elite list's numbered lines, never a number a cancelled or expired registration keeps. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given «Cronometrare» for a race, when «Ultimii sosiți» says «… sosiți din N cu număr», then N is the race numbers the line takes — each confirmed real registration's and each numbered line of the race's elite list, a number once — never a number a cancelled or expired registration keeps retired on its row (§173), a test registration's, or a line without a number (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `results/finish.test.ts`.
